newsitem.title: FRANCE: Geophysique to increase capital by 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Geophysique to increase capital by 25 pct.

text.p: Cie Generale de Geophysique said on Wednesday it had filed a request with the US Securities and Exchange Commission to issue one million shares, increasing its capital 25 percent, in the form of American Depository Shares.

Geophysique said in a statement each share would be represented by five American Depositary Shares (ADS) and would be offered publicly in the United States and placed privately in other countries outside France.
It said it had requested the ADSs be quoted on the New York Stock Exchange.
Geophysique said a date for the sale would be given after it had received the go-ahead from the SEC.
